purpose: MU-S81/KIT: multi-user copy A/B end-slice link endpoint (HOST_EN 0, AB_EN 1) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_lep_mu_ab u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_mem1r1w.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_slice_lep.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.045 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepmu/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepmu/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_lepmu --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_lep_mu_ab --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: MU-S81/KIT 10-19: hardened master of the multi-user copy A/B end-slice link endpoint (MU-S81/LINK 0e11a04bb; new parameter-free top ot_s81sl_lep_mu_ab = ot_s81sl_lep_core MU_EN 1, AB_EN 1, HOST_EN 0, no host / l*_st ports, so no tied pad or constant output). = s81sl_lepnh + user-tag TX window / RX strip (spare XB/XQ bits, 0 wires, 0 cycles) + landing port to dsdv_mu_land + pair B (2 more lanes, 10 more TX SRAM). AB doubles the lane pins (4.46k): W alone would need >= 743 um at 6/um, so pair B goes on the S face (task option), landing on N, ring + mu_c / mu_rt on E. Outline 475.2 x 604.8 (aspect 1.27): 4 x 5 SRAM rows at the lep's 51.84 pitch (B rows at the S face, A rows above), >= 54 um N/S std-cell bands, the lep's 41.9 um W/E bands. Faces: W 2,228 (3.7/um), S 2,232 (4.7/um), N 2,211 (4.65/um), E 2,274 (3.8/um). Clock: 16 region roots by 2-D k-means (clock_split_km.tcl, the s81sl_lep fix of 10-19). MU-S81-2/RX 10-19 (CTS gates: setup into rid failed, lepmua -70.8 ps on 560 paths: rpc -> 8:1 RX row mux -> tag / land decode -> 1,103-bit select fanout; lepmu -575 ps on 600 paths: + pair-B mux and ~300 um): MU_EN 1 RX rebuilt with 0 added cycles -- show-ahead head register per RX lane (hd <= we[rp_nx] ? dq : mem[rp_nx], pointer copy + increment per column group, pop pair-local), a land bit pre-decoded per FIFO row at write (lane 0 XB/XQ ring beat, lane 1 tag && land), rid = one AO222 per bit {cut-through A, cut-through B, replay} with the selects duplicated per 69-bit column group (keep); rpb from nz flops only. MU_EN 0 logic untouched (lep / lep_nh generic netlists equal up to yosys auto-net numbering). Bench tb_s81sl_lep_mu gains a RETURN phase (dies A / B -> the A/B master over pairs A and B, cut-through + landed) and mutant STALEHD. Kit: lep c12b5663c fixes -- pin_reg_split, pin_ranges (l*_f, sl_f, fault at the SW corner beside the fault collector), reset_landing 2 stages; Outline 475.2 x 604.8 -> 475.2 x 691.2: the 20 SRAM rows go in 5 groups of 2 (in-group pitch 51.84, group pitch 125.28) so 4 REAL std-cell channels (22.1 um between halos) cross the full width (the old gates 20261018-234937 / 20261019-003639 sat in GRT congestion extra iterations with NDR disabling 2.5 h+: std cells only in the 21.6-um centre channel, the ~31-um W/E bands and the N/S bands, halos 10.8 closing every inter-row gap, M6 not routable); N band 43.7, S band 43.2 um; faces W 3.2/um, S 4.66/um, N 4.65/um, E 3.3/um. CODEX takeover: shared TXRP=1 read pipeline register, +1 TX lane edge; io_hold_margin 0.03, hold_margin 0.045. No change to static in-die pin sampling; compiler must price the off-die edge.
